data.title: Airline baggage backlog almost cleared
data.description: Thai Airways International (THAI) announced on Monday it had reduced the backlog on delivery of passengers' luggage from flights through Suvanabhumi airport to 862 bags.

data.title: Ngern Tid Lor PLC Wins Two Major Awards at HR Asia Awards 2026
data.description: Ngern Tid Lor Public Company Limited , a subsidiary of Tidlor Holdings (TIDLOR) , has earned recognition on the Asian stage with two major awards at the HR Asia Awards 2026 . The company received the HR Asia Best Companies to Work for in Asia Award - Thailand 2026 for the third consecutive year, as well as the HR Asia People Transformation Awards . The awards reflect its commitment to creating a workplace where employees have opportunities to grow, learn, and continually develop their potential while helping drive sustainable business growth. Miss Nutchanart Arpamongkol , Chief People Officer, and Mr. Kanjanat Chalermjulamanee , Head of Tidlor Academy, accepted the awards on behalf of the company.

data.title: 'STILL : ON' Solo Art Exhibition by Munins Explores the Unstoppable Mind
data.description: River City Bangkok proudly presents “ STILL : ON” , a solo exhibition by Munins that invites viewers to look at the brain as more than just an organ of the human body. It is an essential system that shapes the way we perceive the world, remember experiences, interpret our emotions, and decide how to move forward.

data.title: heygoody.com wins Thailand Technology Excellence Award 2026
data.description: “ heygoody.com ”, a digital insurance brokerage platform operated by Ngern Tid Lor Public Company Limited, a subsidiary of Tidlor Holdings (TIDLOR), has won the Thailand Technology Excellence Award in the Analytics – Insurance Broker category at the Asian Technology Excellence Awards 2026.

data.title: Find – Design Fair Asia to debut in Bangkok
data.description: Find – Design Fair Asia 2026 is gearing up for its inaugural Bangkok edition.

data.title: Man grabs policeman's gun, shoots himself dead
data.description: RAYONG - A 26-year-old man grabbed a policeman's handgun and shot himself dead outside Muang Rayong police station early Monday morning.

data.title: SCOPE Thonglor sells "Penthouse of Penthouses” for B600m
data.description: SCOPE Thonglor has marked a significant milestone for the Ultra-Luxury Residence market with the sale of its exclusive “Penthouse of Penthouses” Triplex Residence, valued at 600 million baht and spanning over 765 square metres.

data.title: AssetWise Pivots to Phuket Megaproject Pipeline to Secure 18.5bn Baht Target
data.description: Bangkok developer AssetWise turns to Phuket's booming leisure residence market and international buyer demand to secure its 18.5 billion baht annual sales target

data.title: Flooding continues in 26 provinces and Bangkok
data.description: Flooding continues to make life difficut for people in parts of Bangkok and 26 provinces, most in the Central Plain region, the Department of Disaster Prevention and Mitigation reported on Monday.

data.title: Spain PM calls early election after housing crisis defeat
data.description: MADRID - Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez on Monday called a snap election for November 29, after parliament rejected housing relief measures proposed by his minority government.

data.title: US arrests woman accused of spying for China on Taiwan leader's family
data.description: LOS ANGELES (UNITED STATES) - A woman accused of spying for China on Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te's son and his family in the United States was arrested Sunday, US and Taiwanese officials said.

data.title: Yemen military announces broad strikes against Houthis
data.description: TAIZ (YEMEN) - The Yemeni military announced a broad set of strikes against Houthi targets on Monday, after the government declared a new campaign to retake all territory even as the Iran-backed group made fresh gains on the ground.

data.title: Myanmar says 10,000 migrants returned from Malaysia this year
data.description: YANGON (MYANMAR) - Myanmar has repatriated nearly 10,000 migrants from Malaysia this year, state media said on Monday, a day after a flotilla returning almost 1,500 of its citizens docked in the country.

data.title: Bangkok canals being drained ahead of more rain
data.description: Flood drainage is being sped up in eastern areas of Bangkok ahead of heavy rain forecast over several days later this week.

data.title: QSNCC, Asean’s first convention centre to receive ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification
data.description: Queen Sirikit National Convention Centre (QSNCC) has received ISO/IEC 27001:2022 certification for its Information Security Management System (ISMS) becoming the first convention centre in Asean to receive this certification. The achievement reflects QSNCC’s efforts to strengthen its management systems and information technology (IT) infrastructure as well as its approach to data security. It reinforces the centre's readiness to deliver services and support international events, including the 2026 IMF-World Bank Group Annual Meetings taking place this October.

data.title: Rescuers spooked, 'dead' dog springs back to life
data.description: KAMPHAENG PHET - Rescuers were spooked when a dog they believed to be dead suddenly sprang back to life in the back of their truck, seen in a video that drew more than 4 million views overnight.

data.title: Pet lovers upset by PM's 'save humans first' flood directive
data.description: Animal lovers on social media are upset by Prime Minister Anutin Charvirakul's advice that people evacuating their flooded homes should initially leave their pets behind and focus on saving human lives first.

data.title: Jeeno Thitikul secures 4th win this season at Lotte Championship
data.description: Jeeno Thitikul didn't ​let a late ⁠double bogey block ⁠her path to a fourth ​LPGA Tour win this year, responding with birdies on the final two holes to secure the Lotte Championship on Sunday ​in Honolulu.

data.title: Thailand hotels and developers expand wellness and sports services
data.description: Thailand's 2027 tourism strategy targets higher-value visitors as hotels and developers add fitness, preventive healthcare and longevity services.

data.title: Toxic flood worries in industrial Prachin Buri
data.description: PRACHIN BURI - Flooding in this eastern industrial province has raised concerns beyond the natural disaster itself, centred on contaminants from factory waste mixing with floodwater and posing a risk to people's lives.

data.title: About 360 people tow Pokemon aircraft at Narita airport
data.description: About 360 children and adults joined forces to tow a roughly 133-tonne Boeing 787 aircraft decorated with Pokemon characters at Narita airport near Tokyo, moving it about 80 metres in an event to spur interest in aviation.

data.title: True Corporation Stands with Thai People, Supporting Flood-Affected Communities
data.description: As continued heavy rainfall and flooding across several areas of Bangkok affect communities with high water levels and travel disruption, True Corporation continues its “True for Thai People” mission, extending assistance, easing the impact on affected communities and standing alongside people throughout the crisis.
